channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Charles Lee | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Charles Lee from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jeff Peterson on Charles Lee
item.description:
“I know guys respect that. It may suck in the moment, you may be embarrassed in the moment, you may not like him in the moment. But if you’re truly about getting better, you realize that it’s never personal with Charles. He just wants what’s best for the team, and he has been there. He’s seen it. He’s won at the highest level. “Charles is also a guy that wants to continue to get better himself. So he’s mostly trying to figure out how he can get better as a coach and push himself. He teaches daily improvement to the guys. He can be hard on guys, but it’s just the way he grew up.”

Jeff Peterson on Charles Lee, Apr 9, 2026. Source: Charlotte Observer.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Charles Lee
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Rick Carlisle:

“I think Charles Lee is one of the best young minds in our game. I'm really impressed with how he's brought this team along.”

Rick Carlisle on Charles Lee, Feb 26, 2026. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Charles Lee
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla:

“I told Charles Lee when he left, ‘I’m not talking to you during the season. I’m not waving to you at the national anthem. I’m not doing that. You’re an enemy.’“So he breached NBA rules and came into the assistant coach locker room and forced me to give him a hug. That could easily be a psychological tell that knocks you off your game competitively. So he knew what he was doing.”

Joe Mazzulla on Charles Lee, Nov 15, 2024. Source: x.com.

item.title: Grant Williams on Charles Lee
item.description:
“I had a relationship with Charles before, because we went to Basketball Without Borders two years prior, so I'd known him from that,”

Grant Williams on Charles Lee, Nov 2, 2024. Source: Boston Sports Journal.

item.title: Jrue Holiday on Charles Lee
item.description:
Jrue Holiday on Charles Lee landing Hornets coaching job:

“I was really happy. Sad to see him go but extremely happy. He deserves it and been with him for a minute now. To see him as a head coach and to beat him every time we play him, it’s going to be great.”

Jrue Holiday on Charles Lee, May 11, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Charles Lee
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on his advice for Charles Lee after taking the Hornets job:

“Everybody hates you. Get used to it. You’re no longer the nice, shiny toy.”

Joe Mazzulla on Charles Lee, May 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Charles Lee
item.description:
Lee has been in the interviewing cycle the last few seasons, but he was promoted to associate head coach at the beginning of this year after Darvin Ham got the Los Angeles Lakers head job.

“Charles Lee is, I think, one of the top guys in our league,”

Mike Budenholzer on Charles Lee, Apr 16, 2023. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Charles Lee
item.description:
The Atlanta Hawks have added Charles Lee and Ben Sullivan to the coaching staff,it was announced today by Head Coach Mike Budenholzer.

“Charles and Ben bring unique skills and abilities to our staff. Both have strong backgrounds in player development that will complement our emphasis on internal team improvement,”

Mike Budenholzer on Charles Lee, Aug 20, 2014. Source: NBA.com.
